label.purpose: Column headers, bay labels, rail labels.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Button, border and hover state changes.

motion.name: strip-update
motion.purpose: Bar width and strip state updates; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single affirmative action on a surface: refresh, retry, run the gated demo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:32px; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid var(--amber-fill); border-radius:2px; background:var(--amber-fill); color:#17130a; font:inherit; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber-fill) 82%, #fff); border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber-fill) 82%, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: details, clear, older, newer, open a dossier.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:32px; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid var(--slip-edge); border-radius:2px; background:var(--slip); color:var(--press); font:inherit; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background:var(--slip-2); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--press); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: State Stamp
components.description: A text-first state mark with a filled square; color reinforces, never replaces, the word.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:2px 7px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal-green) 42%, transparent); border-radius:2px; background:var(--signal-green-soft); color:var(--signal-green); font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:0.56rem; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-stamp::before { content:''; width:0.3rem; height:0.3rem; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Bay Card
components.description: A flat bay separated by a hairline, never a floating shadowed card.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--bay); border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:4px; padding:16px; color:var(--chalk); } .ds-card h2 { margin:0; font-size:0.88rem; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin:4px 0 0; color:var(--chalk-muted); font-size:0.73rem; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: A standard search field inside the card header it scopes.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Search by charge id" />
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:32px; padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius:2px; background:var(--bay-2); color:var(--chalk); font:inherit; font-size:0.78rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--chalk-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; border-color:var(--focus); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: A standard tab in the top utility bar; the active tab is a manila strip pulled from the rack.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:2px; background:var(--topbar); padding:6px; } .ds-nav a { padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:2px; color:var(--topbar-muted); text-decoration:none; font-size:0.76rem; font-weight:550; } .ds-nav a:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:var(--topbar-ink); } .ds-nav a.is-active { background:var(--slip); border-color:var(--slip-edge); color:var(--press); font-weight:700; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Strip Board
components.description: A dark rack of manila strip rows; each row keeps its identity while its state is stamped in place.
components.css: .ds-board { width:100%; border-collapse:separate; border-spacing:0 4px; } .ds-board th { padding:4px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-strong); color:var(--chalk-muted); font-family:var(--font-narrow); font-size:0.64rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; text-align:left; } .ds-strip td { padding:8px 10px; background:var(--slip); border-top:1px solid var(--slip-edge); border-bottom:1px solid var(--slip-edge); color:var(--press); } .ds-strip td:first-child { border-left:1px solid var(--slip-edge); border-right:1px dashed var(--slip-edge); border-radius:2px 0 0 2px; } .ds-strip td:last-child { border-right:1px solid var(--slip-edge); border-radius:0 2px 2px 0; } .ds-strip:hover td { background:var(--slip-2); }

components.name: Revision Chain
components.description: The signature move: a row of punched cells with a tick on the current revision and dashed future cells.
components.css: .ds-chain { display:inline-flex; gap:3px; position:relative; } .ds-chain::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:50%; height:1px; background:color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 26%, transparent); } .ds-chain i { position:relative; z-index:1; width:0.95rem; height:0.68rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 55%, transparent); border-radius:2px; background:var(--slip); } .ds-chain i.done { background:var(--signal-green); border-color:var(--signal-green); } .ds-chain i.current::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:50%; top:-5px; width:2px; height:3px; transform:translateX(-50%); background:currentColor; } .ds-chain i.future { border-style:dashed; }

components.name: Clearance Stamp
components.description: The reconciliation result as a rotated bounded stamp on the manila clearance sheet.
components.css: .ds-clearance { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:2px; padding:6px 9px; border:2px solid currentColor; border-radius:2px; color:var(--signal-green-ink); font-family:var(--font-narrow); font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; line-height:1.1; text-transform:uppercase; transform:rotate(-1.5deg); } .ds-clearance small { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:0.55rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.04em; }

components.name: Drawer Dossier
components.description: A right-side dossier with a manila header strip, a dark bay body and a focus trap.
components.css: .ds-drawer { position:fixed; top:0; right:0; width:min(44rem,100%); height:100vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:var(--bay); border-left:1px solid var(--rule-strong); } .ds-drawer header { padding:14px 16px; background:var(--slip); color:var(--press); border-bottom:1px solid var(--slip-edge); font-weight:650; } .ds-drawer-body { padding:18px; overflow-y:auto; }

narrative.overview: The dashboard is an approach-control strip bay, not a SaaS dashboard. Every webhook arrives as a paper strip, is filed in a bay in time order, and keeps its identity while its state is stamped in place. The surface is a dark rack of charcoal bays with manila paper strips; the world enters through type, palette, density and one signature move; navigation and controls stay standard web controls, because the operator came to read state.
keyCharacteristics: Rack charcoal ground with manila strips as the data surface.
Signal green, amber, red and violet only where they carry domain state.
Archivo for reading and UI, Archivo Narrow for bay labels, Azeret Mono for evidence.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines and 4px rack gaps; no decorative shadows.
Standard top-bar navigation; no permanent sidebar and no terminal costume.
The revision chain and the clearance stamp are the product's signatures.

rules.name: The Signal Is State Rule
rules.body: Signal colors mark domain state, the affirmative action, or the current revision. They never fill a card, a decorative edge, or a hover wash.

rules.name: The Paper Carries Data Rule
rules.body: Manila is the data surface. Do not use it for decoration, page chrome or a second card layer.

rules.name: The Press Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and links on a manila surface use Press Ink, never Chalk. Chalk is for the rack only.

rules.name: The State Is Text Rule
rules.body: A stamp always states its meaning in words. Color may reinforce, never replace, the label.

rules.name: The Monospace Is Measurement Rule
rules.body: Azeret Mono is for IDs, timestamps, amounts, counts, codes and the minute table. It is never body copy, a heading, a button, or a costume for technical.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a border or rack gap can separate two surfaces, no shadow is allowed. Focus is the only state that may paint outside the line.

dos: Do keep data on manila strips and chrome on the rack.
Do draw the revision chain as punched cells: fill done and current, dash future, strike rejected.
Do keep every figure in tabular numerals and every ID in Azeret Mono.
Do state every state in words on a stamp; color is reinforcement.
Do put filters inside the header of the card they filter.
Do let the bay rail hold system health, last clearance, charges by state and late events.
Do test both EN/ES and light/dark at 1920, 1024, 900, 768 and 390.
Do announce counters, pagination and copy feedback with aria-live.
Do trap focus in the drawer and set the shell and the skip link inert while it is open.
donts: Don't add a permanent sidebar; navigation lives in the top utility bar.
Don't use signal colors as decoration, a second accent or a hover wash.
Don't use monospace for prose, headings or buttons.
Don't use shadows, glass, gradient text or one-sided colored bars.
Don't paint the healthy authorized state with the warning tone; use blue.
Don't put Chalk text or links on manila; use Press Ink.
Don't replace the strip board with a standard white table, or the chain with a progress bar.
Don't promote the Demo tab while DEMO_MODE is off.
Don't add a second display face or a new material without a documented reason.
